title: An even-strand Markov calculus for classical and virtual links
abstract: We give an explicit affirmative answer to the ordinary-closure interpretation of Problem 42 in the 2014 survey of Fenn, Ilyutko, Kauffman and Manturov. Four reversible algebraic schemes classify oriented classical link closures using only even-strand braid states. Four additional exchange schemes give the corresponding statement for oriented virtual links. The proof is an elementary conversion of the established unrestricted Markov theorems: positively stabilize each odd-strand vertex and lift every generating edge. Arbitrary finite word blocks are allowed; minimality and uniform geometric locality are not asserted. No historical-priority or present-openness claim is made.
